I will apply some inorganic fertilizer on this plot because rice needs nitrogen to produce a good harvest, but I can only afford about two bags total of urea and DAP for the whole plot. I will also spread manure from our animals, and I will plant improved seed that I saved from last season's harvest. I will not buy pesticides or herbicides since they are too expensive and we can weed by hand with hoes; we also have no irrigation here, so we depend entirely on the rainy season. My family will do most of the work on this plot, but I will hire a few day laborers to help with transplanting and harvesting when the work is too heavy.
